evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 was 4.6 ppm near the established post-purge baseline.
O2 rose to 18.7 ppm during growth despite unchanged temperature and argon setpoints.
O2 reached 26.0 ppm after a sustained rise over successive growth observations, indicating an atmosphere deviation.
Temperature 750.1 °C and argon flow 99.9 sccm track their respective 750 °C and 100 sccm setpoints.
Tube pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, so the required growth atmosphere verification is incomplete.

args.missing_evidence: A calibrated tube-pressure measurement is required to verify the growth atmosphere; independent O2 verification and leak/exhaust-path checks are needed to distinguish air ingress, exhaust restriction, and sensor error. No sample characterization is available.
